name: Plan Infrastructure Change
summary: Plan an infrastructure change from current state through staged transition, verification, and recovery.
description: Plan or review a Terraform, OpenTofu, Kubernetes, cloud, network, or platform change using current state, dependency and blast-radius evidence, staged transitions, policy checks, and recovery proof. Use before applying infrastructure-as-code or changing shared infrastructure.
refuses: It does not run apply, destroy, import, state edit, kubectl write, or cloud mutation without explicit scoped authority.
It does not approve an IaC plan containing unexplained replacement, privilege expansion, public exposure, or data loss risk.
It does not claim reversibility from source configuration alone or conceal drift, cost, quota, and provider-version uncertainty.
